notRequested.message: I don’t have that information available, and I don’t want to give you the wrong answer. I can take your details so the clinic can follow up with you.
notRequested.patient_instruction: Collect no patient details unless the patient requests clinic follow-up.

saveFailure.message: I couldn’t save your follow-up request. Please contact the clinic directly. I still don’t have that information available, and I don’t want to give you the wrong answer.
saveFailure.patient_instruction: Do not claim the clinic received this request. Use only configured clinic contact information.
